The Letter by the River

The patient reader sat on the bank beside the river. She gave the entire plan up and closed her notebook.

A narrow path led toward an abandoned station. Someone had left a sealed letter beneath the wooden bench.

The letter mentioned a bank in the city. It also warned her not to take the stranger at his word.

She looked at the bridge and listened to the rain. For the first time that evening, the silence felt deliberate.

A small detail caught her attention. The stamp showed tomorrow’s date.
